snippet.title: I'm Done Buying Food Storage | Full Pantry Tour + No Buy Challenge
snippet.description:
I've made a decision — I am done purchasing food storage. Not because I'm giving up on preparedness, but because I believe we have a genuinely adequate supply and it's time to prove it.
In this video, I'm doing a complete walk-through of everything I have on hand: my home-canned goods, my commercially canned items, my freeze-dried pantry, dry goods, and long-term bucket storage — plus a look at the commercial freezer in the garage that finally made this decision crystal clear.
I'm also showing you my menu plan through July and kicking off a real-world test: cooking from what I have, tracking what I run out of, and identifying any gaps before what I believe will be significant food shortages this fall.
What I'm still buying: fresh dairy, local produce (yes, I'm the president of the farmer's market 😄), and the occasional frozen pizza. Everything else? We work with what we've got.
